summary: Herman's wife ran off with another man, which haunted him.

blocks.x: JOSEPH VERNON "BIG JOE" TURNER JAZZ ORAL HISTORY TRANSCRIPTION

Joe, there is one thing I have to know. You kept talkin' about Herman the German's wife and how...how ever'body kept warning him about bringin' her down to the club, and then you never said anything happened. Did everything...was everything...did everything turn out all right?
No. She run off with some dude.
Yeah. He got lost. That like to run him crazy. He died with that on his mind.
